title: Camping in the Forest
description: Linh and Minh go camping with their uncle.
instructions: Read about Linh and Minh. Then choose the right answer.

paragraphs.text: ⛺ Last weekend, Linh and her brother Minh went camping in the forest with their uncle.
They walked for two hours. The path was long and the weather was hot. Minh was tired, but Linh was not.
At the top of the hill, they put up the tent next to a small river. Uncle made a fire and cooked sausages.
In the evening, they sat by the fire and sang songs. The sky was clear and they saw hundreds of stars.
At night, Minh heard a strange noise. 'What is that?' he asked. Uncle laughed. 'It is only an owl,' he said.
In the morning, they swam in the river. The water was very cold, but it was fun. They went home after lunch and slept in the car.
